Package com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.config

Class SBPolicy

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.config.SBPolicy
public final class SBPolicy extends Object
Immutable, reloadable view of the server allowlist governing every Source Bucket input and output boundary, including the special non-fluid milk mode.

This class holds no reference to any loader's config machinery; each loader passes its configured content list to refresh(java.util.List<? extends java.lang.String>, java.lang.String).
